papers.extraction_notes: All values are from the Results text; the main text has no tables. Neither the k measurement method nor a neat-PMHS k is in the main text (the conclusions give only a +420% enhancement over pure PMHS); both are probably in the unavailable SI. The text gives no AlN particle size, and only the conclusions call the AlN 'spherical'. Volume fractions are not given. Fig. 4d also has the 55 and 65 wt% points for AlN/PMHS and AlN@PDVB-co-PACl/PMHS (the loadings are named in the TGA discussion); these are figure-only, so figure_only_skipped = 4 is a lower bound. Values from Table S1 (literature) and from the introduction (other papers' 0.31, 0.24, 0.76 and similar values) were skipped.

papers.extraction_notes: Six printed fiber k values. No neat-ANF fiber k is printed. Single fibers measured by TET give k along the fiber axis, recorded as 'in-plane (axial...)'. The text names no BNNS functionalization; exfoliation was done by shear mixing in TfOH with sodium cholate. The other loadings in Fig. 4c (dopes at 10–90 wt% for coaxial and uniaxial fibers, data in Figs. S17–S21) are figure-only: figure_only_skipped = 14 is an estimate (9 loadings × 2 fiber types, minus 4 printed points) and could not be checked without the images. Its own measurements (Table 1) are epoxy filled with silver-coated and uncoated glass microspheres, with no BN or AlN. The h-BN data discussed (cellulose/h-BN core-shell and pristine h-BN in epoxy) are taken from another paper (Ref. [19], Nagaoka et al.), are shown only in Figures 11–12, and Tables 3–4 hold fitted model parameters, not measured composite k.

papers.reason_if_not_usable: No thermal conductivity measured or reported. papers.extraction_notes: Quality caveat: the reported values look physically implausible. The neat crosslinked copolymers give 5.65–5.77 W/(mK), and the PbO and BN composites give 11–25 W/(mK), from a basic steady-state set-up with a 35–90 °C inlet temperature. Values were extracted as printed. Consider flagging or excluding this paper. PbO-only samples (NCPSPb2–5, 7–10, 12–15, e.g. 22.91 and 24.90 W/(mK)) were excluded because they contain no BN. The BN-containing samples NCPSBN20, NCPSPbBN21, NCPSPbBN22 and NCPSBN24 have only % increases printed, with absolute values in Fig. 5 only, so they are counted as figure-only (4). Comparison values from the literature in the Introduction and in the Table 3 rows [79–82] were skipped. Loadings are taken from Table 1 and are wt% of the whole composite.
